_comment: Kiosk settings (no secrets). Command-line flags override these (py -3.11 app.py --help). mode: esp32 = the bin (load cell + YOLO on the tray + ESP32 sorting), sim = the same flow with a simulated ESP32 (labelled SIMULATION, staff key I places an item), camera / attendant = testing without hardware. Missing keys fall back to defaults; the older names 'sorter' and 'serial_baud' are still read.
